label: Trolley joint models (inference)
rule: Explicit witness assignments on the actual case descriptions
meaning: Nonvacuity: on the four stated case descriptions, assigning permissibility by each principle yields a model of that principle, all case facts and the common triad; the causal reading of double effect and the causal means principle with loop impermissible, the intention reading and redirection with loop permissible. Models of consistency only; the senses appear side by side, not mixed.
